import bpy, os, base64, pathlib
base=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\blender_bridge\previews')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
sources=[('perfil',pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda\renders\chatgpt_calibracao_perfil.png')),('planta',pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda\renders\chatgpt_calibracao_planta.png'))]
for label,src in sources:
    if not src.exists(): raise RuntimeError('missing '+str(src))
    out=base/f'calibracao_{label}_tiny.jpg'
    img=bpy.data.images.load(str(src),check_existing=False);img.scale(160,96);img.filepath_raw=str(out);img.file_format='JPEG';img.save();bpy.data.images.remove(img)
    data=base64.b64encode(out.read_bytes()).decode('ascii')
    chunk=900;parts=[data[i:i+chunk] for i in range(0,len(data),chunk)]
    for i,p in enumerate(parts):(base/f'calibracao_{label}_tiny_{i:02d}.txt').write_text(p,encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'{label.upper()}_TINY bytes={out.stat().st_size} chunks={len(parts)} chars={len(data)}')
print('CALIBRATION_TINY_PREVIEWS_OK')
